scope: Post-hoc synthesis requested by user: completed F01/F02/F03/F04/F06/F07. Read frozen artifacts; no training, rollout, feature search, predictor refit or experiment change.
status: Exploratory comparison after reading previous reports, not preregistration or independent replication.
decisions: 36 suite/original/checkpoint/continuation cells per method and mode. Equal A/B/C weights, A200/A400 half each; same and cross repeat kept separate. Compare each candidate to its own stated baseline; do not rank candidates by incompatible increments.
audit: Recompute weighted selected outcomes, MAE, changes and worst-task-drop differences; reconstruct selected O from branch-level features and chosen allocations from frozen predictions. Compare common baselines across versions. List ALL primary changed choices and top-two prediction margins.
headroom: Observed hindsight best among five fixed branches, same O cases. Descriptive upper reference subject to max-selection bias; not true oracle, not an available policy and not cost-adjusted gain.
critic_followup: One exploratory link: F06 critic normalized total20 train-minus-other-panel improvement gap versus absolute O40-D20 discrepancy. Report Spearman overall, by four context groups and three original seed blocks, no p-values, no thresholds or candidate selection. O40-D20 combines evaluation-case differences and temporal change. Raw signed gap retained; no positive-only clipping.
limitations: The six analyses reuse largely the SAME historical experiment, three original seed blocks and two task-composition extensions. No evidence pooling as independent replications. F07 uses a different rule/diagnostic budget and is not put into the same candidate-increment ranking. No tuning from this inspection. Future hypotheses must be fixed before fresh data.
